data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 was GBP 88.097m. Using the gross claims development table, older underwriting years (2014-2016) show a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 5.44m (6.18% of opening reserves), driven principally by adverse claims development and large loss development (notably property catastrophe activity). The report also notes an overall prior-year deficit of GBP 9.0m (statement does not explicitly state gross/net). A number of named catastrophe events across 2017-2018 (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, California wildfires, Hawaii volcanic eruption, Florence, Michael) are discussed as material influences on reserving and claims experience. Reserve estimates have been conservatively managed and the syndicate has acted to commute certain US casualty contracts, reducing reserve risk.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2018, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves (2017:deficit GBP 1.8m).
We have commuted a material US Casualty contract at a profit, removing a significant amount of reserve risk from this year.
material losses from Hurricanes Harvey and Irma and more modest losses from Hurricane Maria
the 2017 calendar year wildfires in Northern and Southern California, the mudslides in Southern California and the earthquakes in Mexico have not generated material claims to the Syndicate
the volcanic eruption on Hawaii, hurricanes Florence and Michael and the California wildfires are expected to impact 2017 and 2018 years of account

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (prior-year comparative column). No explicit gross 'movement in prior years' line was provided; prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) as a fallback. The report also states a prior-year 'deficit of GBP 9.0m' but does not specify gross vs net - that narrative figure appears to be net (after reinsurance). The computed gross PYD from the triangle is +GBP 5.443m (adverse). LOB-level prior-year movements are not explicitly quantified in the report; lob_movements therefore use inferred directions with low confidence. RDS scenario losses provided in risk management table are included as named events with explicit estimated net losses.
